fit_reason: This is a consignment listing handled by Knotty Oar Marina, not a private owner selling directly; inquiries go to the marina, so it is effectively dealer stock.
findings: Pontoon tubes on both sides look fairly bright and even, with no obvious heavy oxidation or waterline scum visible
Bronze side panels and upholstery look clean and glossy from the distance shown
Interior is only seen from outside the boat, so the condition of the seating and floor can't be judged closely
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2019 Crest 240 SL. The tubes and panels already look clean in the photos, but if you'd ever like a pre-sale detail or a tube polish, we come to you. Would you like a quote?
